scope: Current Arcade touch and motion interaction, save/load validation, action acceptance, event journal, navigation and discovery boundaries

findings.title: Incomplete saved matches can strand a matching round
findings.classification: Controlled malformed-save reproduction; not an observed production incident
findings.evidence: The original validator accepted matched=[0] and unrelated two-card matches. Disabled matched cards then cannot form their complete pair.
findings.resolution: Require each matched group to contain exactly two cards; reject the decoded session and allow a fresh game. Local commit 7ccf0144; final standalone engine count 10606, including complete legacy-pair compatibility.

findings.title: Supporting text and card captions need clearer contrast and wrapping
findings.classification: Readability improvement with remaining automated contrast diagnostics
findings.resolution: Use opaque supporting text and a dark, vertically wrapping caption backing. Retain all contrast diagnostics separately; two representative solid-pixel samples are readable but do not prove global contrast.

findings.title: Expanded lobby title may clip with increased text size
findings.classification: Reproduced automated finding; the remaining underlying visual defect is not identified
findings.resolution: Two-column lobby layout clears named Director’s Cut and Movie Heist title warnings. Final strict audits retain two unmapped clipping findings on iPhone and four on iPad; both navigation checks pass. Hold a new upload and do not suppress the remaining structural reports.

verified_checks: Cancelled or stale tile callbacks are guarded by current seed and board; model rejects invalid slots, solved boards and completed rounds.
Memory labels do not expose face-down identities; both visual faces remain hidden from the accessibility tree.
Animations do not control scoring or saving; system Reduce Motion removes the added animations.
Accepted-action journal rejects terminal callbacks, pauses inactive intervals, and bounds persisted run records.
residual_risks: Physical device gestures, VoiceOver user experience, live current-build telemetry and CloudKit synchronization remain unverified.
testing_gaps: Unmapped expanded-lobby clipping and gradient/poster contrast diagnostics require further inspection.
Physical TestFlight, VoiceOver, current-build production telemetry and CloudKit remain unverified.

controller_findings.title: Casting iPad test waits for a virtualized actor without scrolling
evidence: The iPad run failed on waitForExistence for arcade.choice.31 before any scroll call.
The shared actor grid is lazy and the iPad sheet viewport does not expose the second row initially.
The viewport-aware scrolling helper passed the same Casting scenario on both the final iPhone and iPad app.
controller_findings.classification: Confirmed test-controller issue; corrected and passed on both devices
